camera.lore.legendary: Took a group photo so wide that it fitted the whole town in, and now every house in town gets a copy every New Year, including the bakery.
camera.lore.epic: Flashed at the exact moment the wedding cake was cut, and the whole wedding album came out as one big white blur with a fork in it.

x_camera_lens.lore.rare: Zooms in on the one thing nobody wants to see, like the spot on your nose, in perfect, crystal-clear detail.
x_camera_lens.lore.legendary: Took a photo of a hedgehog so sharp that everyone who looked at it said ouch and checked their fingers.

x_cinema_camera.lore.rare: Shouts CUT in the director's voice at random, so the actors keep freezing halfway through a sneeze.
x_cinema_camera.lore.legendary: Filmed one scene for so long that the actors grew real beards, and the sequel had to begin with a shave.

x_film_camera.lore.rare: Swaps its film with someone else's at the shop, so the family album now has a stranger riding a camel in it.
x_film_camera.lore.legendary: Took a photo so old-fashioned that everyone in it came out in black and white, including the brand-new red car.

x_instant_camera.lore.rare: Prints what people were thinking instead of what they looked like, so the party photos are mostly cake.
x_instant_camera.lore.legendary: Printed a photo so fast that it came out before the picture was taken, and everyone had to copy their own poses.

i_lens_cap.lore.epic: Popped off at the top of the mountain and rolled all the way down, and the whole hiking group chased it into the cafe.
i_lens_cap.lore.legendary: Stayed on through a whole solar eclipse, so its owner is the only person with no eclipse photos and perfectly safe eyes.

x_video_camera.lore.rare: Records everything in fast-forward, so Grandma's birthday speech lasts four seconds and sounds like a mouse.
x_video_camera.lore.epic: Filmed the whole school play with the lens cap on, so the cast had to perform it again in the living room.
x_video_camera.lore.legendary: Recorded a birthday party on a tape so long that it also caught the next ten birthdays and the dog's first swim.

x_action_camera.lore.rare: Sticks to anything that moves, so the family's best holiday film was shot from the back of a seagull.
x_action_camera.lore.legendary: Was stuck to a tortoise for a whole year and made the slowest, most popular adventure film ever.

x_webcam_unit.lore.epic: Turned on a cat filter during the head teacher's online assembly, and the whole school was led by a kitten for an hour.
x_webcam_unit.lore.legendary: Lagged so far behind that it showed last Tuesday's meeting instead, and everyone agreed it went much better.

x_security_monitor.lore.rare: Shows a different room from the one its camera points at, so the guard has watched the staff kitchen all night.
x_security_monitor.lore.epic: Showed one pigeon on every screen at once, and the guards spent the night chasing a single bird round the shopping centre.
x_security_monitor.lore.legendary: Stared at one parked car so hard all night that the car got nervous and quietly moved itself to the next street.

x_baby_monitor.lore.rare: Picks up the baby next door instead, so the parents rush in to comfort a cot that is already fast asleep.
x_baby_monitor.lore.epic: Played one tiny snore through the house so loudly that the whole family got dressed for school at midnight.
x_baby_monitor.lore.legendary: Played a lullaby back so softly that both parents fell asleep, and the baby had to switch the monitor off.

x_photo_booth.lore.rare: Squeezes one extra person into every photo strip, and nobody ever knows who they are.
x_photo_booth.lore.legendary: Fitted a whole football team, the referee and the mascot into one tiny booth, and printed them all on one strip.

flat_tv.lore.rare: Switches to the cooking channel whenever anyone is hungry, so dinner is late every single night.
flat_tv.lore.epic: Showed a penalty kick so realistically that the whole living room dived for the ball, and the sofa never recovered.
flat_tv.lore.legendary: Showed a fireplace video so convincingly that the cat sleeps in front of it and the heating bill went down.

game_console.lore.legendary: Paused a game so hard that the whole house paused too, and Dad is still standing in the hall with one sock on.
game_console.lore.epic: Started an update during the sleepover that lasted so long the guests went home, grew up and came back to play.

monitor.lore.epic: Showed the boss's screensaver on the big meeting screen, and the whole office found out he collects garden gnomes.
monitor.lore.legendary: Had so many windows open that one let in a real breeze, and the office switched its fans off for the summer.

binoculars.lore.rare: Makes everything look so close that its owner keeps ducking whenever a bird flies past a mile away.
binoculars.lore.epic: Was lent to a short-sighted owl at the nature reserve, and the owl has refused to give them back ever since.
binoculars.lore.legendary: Looked so far into the distance that it saw all the way round the world to the back of its owner's own head.

i_beacon.lore.rare: Flashes in a pattern that seagulls cannot resist, so the harbour fills with confused birds every evening.
i_beacon.lore.epic: Flashed so hard into the storm that the clouds blinked first and went home early.
i_beacon.lore.legendary: Shone so far out to sea that a whale followed it into the harbour and asked where to park.

x_ceiling_light.lore.rare: Switches itself off the second anyone sits down, and back on the moment they stand up to check.
x_ceiling_light.lore.legendary: Shone so brightly through the night that the neighbour's rooster crowed at midnight for a month.

x_chandelier.lore.rare: Turns every crystal into a tiny mirror, so nobody at dinner can pull a face behind their napkin.
x_chandelier.lore.legendary: Rang its crystals so sweetly during a storm that the thunder stopped to listen and moved next door.

x_chandelier_light.lore.legendary: Dimmed itself so romantically at an anniversary dinner that Grandad proposed to Grandma again, and she said maybe.

x_desk_light.lore.uncommon: Gets so warm over the homework that the cat sleeps on the maths book every evening.
x_desk_light.lore.rare: Bends round to read over your shoulder, and tuts at every spelling mistake.
x_desk_light.lore.epic: Shone on the homework so hard that the answers faded off the page, and the whole class had a very good excuse.
x_desk_light.lore.legendary: Stretched its neck so far that it reached the street lamp outside, and now the whole road does homework under it.

x_floor_light.lore.rare: Leans over whoever sits in the armchair, so every visitor feels like they're being interviewed.
x_floor_light.lore.epic: Fell over at the party and lit up the ceiling, so the guests spent all night doing shadow puppets on it.
x_floor_light.lore.legendary: Stood so still in the corner that the family mistook it for Grandad and knitted it a cardigan.

x_light_stand.lore.rare: Lights everyone from below at the worst moment, so the wedding photos look like a ghost story.
x_light_stand.lore.epic: Toppled over in the middle of the fashion shoot, and the model's surprised face started a whole new fashion.
x_light_stand.lore.legendary: Stretched its three legs so tall that it lit the whole town from above, and the pigeons complained about the glare.

x_pendant_light.lore.uncommon: Swings like a pendulum every time someone sneezes, and the family sets their watches by it.
x_pendant_light.lore.rare: Shines only on the plate of whoever is last to finish their vegetables.
x_pendant_light.lore.epic: Swung so low at the kitchen party that it dipped into the punch bowl and turned everyone's drinks orange.
x_pendant_light.lore.legendary: Hung so low for so long that the kitchen table grew up to meet it, and now dinner is eaten standing.

x_reading_light.lore.epic: Clipped onto the wrong book at bedtime, so Dad read the whole family a car manual in his best dragon voice.
x_reading_light.lore.legendary: Read so many books by itself after lights out that it now does all the voices better than Dad.

x_ring_light.lore.uncommon: Makes faces so smooth that Grandad's video call came back without his eyebrows.
x_ring_light.lore.rare: Switches on so brightly in a dark room that the houseplants turn to face it and the curtains open by themselves.
x_ring_light.lore.epic: Was the only light on in the street during a power cut, so the whole street queued for passport photos.
x_ring_light.lore.legendary: Made a cake look so perfect on camera that the cake started believing it and refused to be eaten.

x_studio_light.lore.epic: Got so hot during a live cooking show that it baked the presenter's bread before the oven did.
x_studio_light.lore.legendary: Lit a weather forecast so brightly that the real sun came out the next day just to compete.

x_wall_lamp.lore.uncommon: Hums one quiet note all evening, and everyone who walks down the hall ends up humming it too.
x_wall_lamp.lore.rare: Switches on at the exact moment someone sneaks downstairs for a midnight biscuit.
x_wall_lamp.lore.epic: Flickered so spookily in the old hotel corridor that the guests checked out and a ghost checked in.
x_wall_lamp.lore.legendary: Welcomed visitors so warmly that the postman moved into the hallway, and now gets his own letters there.

lantern.lore.rare: Throws its carrier's shadow ten times bigger, so every night walk meets a wobbly giant on the hedge.
lantern.lore.epic: Was held up on the school night walk, and every moth in the forest followed the class back onto the coach.
lantern.lore.legendary: Shone so steadily one winter night that the Moon took the evening off and nobody noticed.

x_lantern_light.lore.rare: Swings its light so hypnotically that whoever carries it walks in circles until morning.
x_lantern_light.lore.epic: Was swung so hard at the harvest parade that the whole village followed it straight into the duck pond.
x_lantern_light.lore.legendary: Swung so far on its handle that it went right round the world and came back from the other side.

x_oil_lantern.lore.epic: Puffed so much soot at the barn dance that everyone went home looking like chimney sweeps.
x_oil_lantern.lore.legendary: Burned on one drop of oil all winter, and the barn owl did its homework under it every night.

x_paper_lantern.lore.rare: Glows brighter whenever someone in the room tells a fib, which makes birthday surprises very hard.
x_paper_lantern.lore.epic: Blew off its string at the garden party and bounced down the street, and the whole party chased it to the bus stop.
x_paper_lantern.lore.legendary: Glowed so softly that a family of fireflies moved in, and now it never needs switching on.

x_flashlight_torch.lore.common: Rolls off the table and points straight in your eyes every time you go to pick it up.
x_flashlight_torch.lore.legendary: Shone so bravely into the cupboard under the stairs that the monster living there moved out and left a thank-you note.

x_torch_light.lore.rare: Finds every spider in the garden at night and shines on it until everyone screams.
x_torch_light.lore.legendary: Shone up so hard one night that it wrote its name on a cloud, and the cloud still spells it at sunset.

x_candelabra.lore.epic: Dripped so much wax at the banquet that the roast chicken came out wearing a little candle hat.
x_candelabra.lore.legendary: Kept five flames so steady in a gale that the castle flag blew away and the candles did not even flicker.

x_candle_holder.lore.rare: Makes its candle lean sideways, so every shadow in the room looks like it's in a hurry.
x_candle_holder.lore.epic: Held so many candles on Grandad's cake that the smoke alarm sang along before anyone else did.
x_candle_holder.lore.legendary: Kept a candle burning so slowly that it took all winter to melt one inch, and spring arrived to find it still going.

x_glow_stick.lore.epic: Was dropped into the school swimming pool, and the swimming lesson turned into a glowing disco.
x_glow_stick.lore.legendary: Glowed so green at the bottom of the garden that the neighbours reported a tiny alien landing.

x_headlamp.lore.epic: Was worn backwards on the school camping trip, so the whole class followed their teacher's head the wrong way to the toilets.

x_light_bar.lore.epic: Flashed so fast at the road-safety day that the lollipop lady started directing traffic with disco moves.
x_light_bar.lore.legendary: Flashed so brightly in a traffic jam that every car shuffled aside to let the ice-cream van through first.

x_neon_sign.lore.epic: Flickered its arrow so wildly one night that the delivery vans all tried to park on the diner roof.
x_neon_sign.lore.legendary: Glowed so pink one night that the moon blushed too, and it has looked a little pink ever since.

x_night_light.lore.epic: Glowed so cosily during a thunderstorm that the thunder curled up on the landing and fell asleep too.
x_night_light.lore.legendary: Glowed so bravely that the monster under the bed moved out, and now sends a postcard from the seaside every summer.

lightbulb.lore.rare: Lights up over the head of anyone with an idea, so nobody in the house can keep a surprise secret.
lightbulb.lore.epic: Popped during the school play, so the cast finished it in the dark doing every sound effect with their mouths.
lightbulb.lore.legendary: Had such a bright idea that it invented a lamp, then a lighthouse, then a very small sun for the garden shed.

x_lava_lamp.lore.legendary: Bubbled so slowly that one blob took a whole year to rise, and the family threw it a party when it reached the top.

x_salt_lamp.lore.common: Glows so dimly that every guest asks if it is switched on, and then pokes it to check.
x_salt_lamp.lore.epic: Calmed the staff meeting so much that nobody could remember what they were arguing about, and lunch started early.
x_salt_lamp.lore.legendary: Soaked up so much damp on one rainy day that the whole street's washing dried at once.

x_reflector.lore.rare: Shines back so brightly that every cat on the wall stops to stare at it all night.
x_reflector.lore.epic: Caught the headlights so well on the night ride that every car slowed down just to wave at the bikes.
x_reflector.lore.legendary: Shone back at a lighthouse so brightly that the lighthouse thought it had a twin, and they still blink at each other every night.

x_drum_machine.lore.rare: Speeds up a tiny bit every bar, so every song ends with the band sprinting.
x_drum_machine.lore.epic: Got stuck on one beat at the wedding, and the guests had to dance until the caretaker found the plug.
x_drum_machine.lore.legendary: Played a beat so catchy that the washing machine, the kettle and the dog all learned it by teatime.

x_harmonium.lore.rare: Breathes in so hard that it sucks the sheet music off the stand, and sometimes the curtains.
x_harmonium.lore.legendary: Played one note so long that a whole cow fell asleep standing up, then the farmer, then the tractor.

x_keytar.lore.rare: Makes whoever wears it play every song twice as fast, including the slow one at the wedding.
x_keytar.lore.epic: Played a solo so long that the drummer went home, made tea and came back for the ending.
x_keytar.lore.legendary: Hit a note so high that only bats could hear it, and the bats asked for an encore.

x_mixing_desk.lore.rare: Turns up whoever is singing worst, so every concert stars the dad at the back.
x_mixing_desk.lore.epic: Had one slider nudged by a passing goose, and the festival field heard nothing but bass for an hour.
x_mixing_desk.lore.legendary: Mixed a concert so perfectly that the echo came back a week later to say well done.

x_record_player.lore.rare: Plays every record a little too fast, so every singer sounds like a squirrel in a hurry.
x_record_player.lore.epic: Played a record backwards at the family party, and every guest walked home in reverse.
x_record_player.lore.legendary: Played a record so old that the singer on it phoned up to ask for a copy.

x_synth_keyboard.lore.rare: Turns every note into a different animal, so the wedding march came out as a duck, a goat and a sea lion.
x_synth_keyboard.lore.legendary: Made a thunder sound so real that the weather forecast changed, and the town brought umbrellas to the beach.

x_turntable.lore.rare: Spins any record it touches at disco speed, including the lullaby, so the baby now breakdances.
x_turntable.lore.epic: Spun so fast at the school disco that the whole hall turned round, and everyone left by the wrong door.
x_turntable.lore.legendary: Scratched a record so hard that it carved a brand-new song into it, and the band had to learn it.

i_ipod.lore.rare: Shuffles to the most embarrassing song the moment its headphones fall out on the bus.
i_ipod.lore.epic: Got plugged into the school speakers by mistake, and the fire drill happened to a disco remix.
i_ipod.lore.legendary: Fitted so many songs in such a small box that a whole brass band climbed out when it was opened.

x_ipod_nano.lore.uncommon: Is so small that people keep mistaking it for a stick of chewing gum.
x_ipod_nano.lore.rare: Plays songs with exactly the wrong beat, so its jogger ends up skipping like a lamb.
x_ipod_nano.lore.epic: Played a march so loudly at the fun run that every runner finished in step, including a dog that wasn't in the race.
x_ipod_nano.lore.legendary: Went through the washing machine so many times that every song now comes out with bubbles in it.

x_mp3_player.lore.rare: Slips one song its owner has never heard into every playlist, and it's always a sea shanty.
x_mp3_player.lore.legendary: Played one road-trip song so often that the car learned to sing it, and now hums along at traffic lights.

x_overhead_projector.lore.epic: Melted a sheet during the lesson, so the whole class learned a map of a country shaped like a sock.
x_overhead_projector.lore.legendary: Projected a sum so big across the school hall that next year's class is still solving it.

projector.lore.rare: Shows every film a little too big, so the hero's head is on the ceiling and his feet are in the kitchen.
projector.lore.epic: Shone a shark film onto the neighbour's swimming pool, and nobody swam in it all summer.
projector.lore.legendary: Projected a sunrise onto the clouds so convincingly that the whole town got up two hours early.

x_projector_lamp.lore.rare: Shines so brightly that the shadow of one passing fly fills the whole cinema screen.
x_projector_lamp.lore.epic: Blew during the big film premiere, so the actors had to stand up and perform the ending live.
x_projector_lamp.lore.legendary: Shone its beam out of the cinema window so far that the next town watched the film on its clouds for free.

x_slide_projector.lore.rare: Slips one embarrassing slide into every show, usually Dad in his swimming trunks.
x_slide_projector.lore.epic: Jammed during the holiday show, so the family stared at a picture of one goat for the rest of the evening.
x_slide_projector.lore.legendary: Showed a beach holiday so vividly on the living-room wall that the family came back from the sofa with suntans.

x_clock_radio.lore.epic: Tuned itself to a cooking show at six in the morning, and the whole family woke up starving and making pancakes.
x_clock_radio.lore.legendary: Woke up a bear hibernating in the garden shed, and the bear asked for five more minutes.

x_portable_radio.lore.rare: Picks up the phone calls from next door between songs, so the whole picnic hears about Auntie's bunions.
x_portable_radio.lore.epic: Lost its signal halfway through the big match, so the whole beach had to make up the score.
x_portable_radio.lore.legendary: Picked up a station so far away that it played next year's music, and the family already knows the summer hit.

radio.lore.rare: Changes station by itself the moment anyone starts to sing along.
radio.lore.epic: Read out the weather so gloomily that the sun went back in, and the street barbecue was rained off.
radio.lore.legendary: Tuned in so carefully that it found a station run entirely by hedgehogs, and their quiz is very hard.

i_cassette.lore.rare: Slows every song down when its batteries get low, so the party ends in one long sleepy yawn.
i_cassette.lore.epic: Was flipped to side B on the coach, and side B turned out to be Dad practising the bagpipes.
i_cassette.lore.legendary: Was rewound with a pencil so fast that it went back in time and recorded a dinosaur.

x_cassette_tape.lore.common: Has its label written in such tiny handwriting that nobody knows which songs are on it.
x_cassette_tape.lore.rare: Records over the best bit of everything, so Grandad's birthday message now ends with the weather forecast.
x_cassette_tape.lore.epic: Was taped from the radio with the DJ talking over every song, so the whole class sang the DJ's words at the school concert.
x_cassette_tape.lore.legendary: Recorded a secret message so clearly that the whole town played it backwards, and it said please tidy your room.

x_tape_deck.lore.common: Clicks off with a loud clunk the moment the song gets good, and never during the boring bit.
x_tape_deck.lore.epic: Played the school concert recording at double speed, and the parents clapped twice as fast to keep up.
x_tape_deck.lore.legendary: Made a mixtape so good that the songs on it met up and started a band together.

x_cd.lore.epic: Was hung in the garden to scare the birds, and every magpie in town came to dance in its rainbows.
x_cd.lore.legendary: Spun out of the car window so fast that it went round the roundabout and flew back in.

x_cd_changer.lore.rare: Swaps the disc halfway through a song, so every chorus belongs to a different band.
x_cd_changer.lore.epic: Got stuck between two discs at the party, and the guests danced to a lullaby and a brass band at once.
x_cd_changer.lore.legendary: Shuffled its five discs so cleverly that it invented a sixth album that nobody ever bought.

x_vinyl_record.lore.rare: Warps in the sun until every song on it sounds seasick, even the lullabies.
x_vinyl_record.lore.epic: Was skimmed across the picnic like a flying saucer, and landed on the fair's record player still playing.
x_vinyl_record.lore.legendary: Has one groove so long that its last song has never finished, and the family plans holidays around it.

x_jukebox.lore.rare: Swallows coins and plays whatever it likes, which is always a song about a lonely cowboy.
x_jukebox.lore.legendary: Played one record so many times that the record learned to play itself, and the jukebox now just watches.

x_guitar_amp.lore.epic: Was turned up so loud at band practice that the garage door opened by itself and the car rolled out to escape.
x_guitar_amp.lore.legendary: Played one chord so loud that it was still echoing round the valley a year later, and the sheep had learned it.

x_karaoke_machine.lore.epic: Gave the cat a perfect score, so the whole party had to sit through an encore of meowing.
x_karaoke_machine.lore.legendary: Scored Grandad's singing so highly that he believed it, and he now tours every village hall in the county.

x_soundbar.lore.uncommon: Makes every whisper on TV sound like it's coming from behind the sofa.
x_soundbar.lore.legendary: Played a film earthquake so realistically that the dog next door dug itself a shelter in the garden.

speaker.lore.rare: Plays from whichever phone is nearest, so the party music keeps turning into Grandma's voicemail.

x_megaphone.lore.rare: Turns every whisper into a shout, so the whole school knows everybody's secrets by lunch.
x_megaphone.lore.epic: Announced the egg-and-spoon race so loudly that every egg in the box cracked at once.
x_megaphone.lore.legendary: Shouted LUNCH across the playing fields so loudly that the school in the next town came too.

x_megaphone_horn.lore.uncommon: Turns every voice into a robot's, so the lifeguard sounds like a toaster.
x_megaphone_horn.lore.rare: Calls so loudly across the beach that the tide comes in early to see what the fuss is about.
x_megaphone_horn.lore.epic: Announced the ice-cream van so loudly that every boat in the harbour raced back to the beach.
x_megaphone_horn.lore.legendary: Honked so loudly from the pier that a passing ferry honked back, and the two have been best friends ever since.

x_arcade_machine.lore.epic: Let a seagull beat the high score, and now every seagull on the pier demands a go.
x_arcade_machine.lore.legendary: Was played so well by one grandma that the game ran out of levels and had to invent a new one just for her.

x_atm_machine.lore.rare: Pays out in the smallest coins when it's grumpy, so everyone leaves jingling like a piggy bank.
x_atm_machine.lore.epic: Gave everyone a receipt instead of money on fair day, so the whole fair was paid for in paper slips.
x_atm_machine.lore.legendary: Paid out a whole bag of coins to a squirrel by mistake, and the squirrel now owns a very fancy nest.

x_slot_machine.lore.rare: Makes three cherries line up on everything nearby, so the fruit bowl now holds nothing but cherries.
x_slot_machine.lore.epic: Had its lever pulled by a passing beach donkey, and the donkey got three lemons and looked very sour.
x_slot_machine.lore.legendary: Spun its reels so fast that it launched a cherry into the sky, and the cherry still circles the pier at teatime.

x_ticket_machine.lore.rare: Prints tickets to stations that don't exist, and the passengers somehow get there anyway.
x_ticket_machine.lore.epic: Printed one ticket so long that the conductor had to check it carriage by carriage.
x_ticket_machine.lore.legendary: Sold a ticket to somewhere so far away that the train is still going, and it sends a postcard every year.

x_vending_kiosk.lore.epic: Dropped every snack at once when someone thumped it, and the office ate crisps for lunch all week.
x_vending_kiosk.lore.legendary: Took one coin from a toddler and gave back a bicycle, and nobody knows how it fitted.

x_battery.lore.common: Goes in the wrong way round every time, even though there is a little picture showing how.
x_battery.lore.rare: Swaps places with a dead battery in the drawer every night, so nobody ever knows which is which.
x_battery.lore.epic: Was put in backwards, so the robot dog walked backwards round the birthday party for an hour.
x_battery.lore.legendary: Powered a clock so well that the clock ran on into next week, and the family is now always early.

x_flashlight_battery.lore.uncommon: Rolls off the table and under the fridge the moment it's taken out of the packet.
x_flashlight_battery.lore.rare: Hops out of the torch whenever a spider appears, and leaves its owner alone in the dark with it.
x_flashlight_battery.lore.epic: Ran out at the campfire story just as someone shouted BOO, and three tents fell down from the jump.
x_flashlight_battery.lore.legendary: Powered a torch for so long that the torch retired first, and the battery took a new job in the doorbell.

x_charger.lore.legendary: Was borrowed so often that it has visited more countries than its owner, and has the luggage stickers to prove it.

x_power_bank.lore.rare: Charges every phone in the room except its owner's, which it pretends not to see.
x_power_bank.lore.epic: Was lent to a friend at the festival, then to their friend, then theirs, and came home three weeks later with a tan.
x_power_bank.lore.legendary: Charged a phone so full that the phone started charging the power bank back, and they've argued about it ever since.

x_power_strip.lore.legendary: Grew a new socket every time someone needed one, and now stretches round the whole room like a snake.

x_plug.lore.epic: Was pulled out by mistake during the bake-off, so every cake in the oven came out exactly half baked.
x_plug.lore.legendary: Was plugged in so firmly that when the family moved house, they had to take the wall with them.

x_wireless_charger.lore.rare: Pulls phones across the bedside table towards it like a magnet, and the glass of water too.
x_wireless_charger.lore.epic: Charged the sleepover's phones so slowly that everyone had to talk to each other all night.

x_thermostat.lore.rare: Sets itself to tropical whenever nobody is looking, so the houseplants have started growing bananas.
x_thermostat.lore.epic: Was turned up so high at the winter party that the snowman in the garden came inside for a cold drink.
x_thermostat.lore.legendary: Turned the heating so high one winter that spring came early to the whole street, and the daffodils were furious.

x_fire_extinguisher.lore.legendary: Foamed a barbecue so thoroughly that the sausages came out tasting of lemon meringue.

x_fire_extinguisher_bottle.lore.rare: Sneezes a puff of white powder whenever someone mentions candles, so birthday parties come out very white.

x_floppy_disk.lore.legendary: Held a game so tiny that its characters climbed out at night to stretch their legs.

x_intercom.lore.rare: Mixes up who is calling, so the pizza driver gets invited in for Grandma's tea.
x_intercom.lore.legendary: Crackled so badly that one visitor's hello came out as a perfect opera song, and the whole building clapped.

x_dvd.lore.epic: Had a bonus feature longer than the film, and the family is still watching the bloopers.
x_dvd.lore.legendary: Was watched so many times that the actors started waving at the family.
